reading.body:
Digital Realty IAD40 is one of 326 mapped data center facilities in Virginia, though only 23 published power capacity figures statewide. This building holds 223,500 square feet in Ashburn, part of Digital Realty's Northern Virginia campus spanning multiple named facilities across Loudoun and surrounding counties. The operator publishes no megawatt capacity for this specific building, making it impossible to estimate its AI hosting potential or rank it against other sites by compute density.

The facility qualifies as 2N+2 cooling redundant, meaning it can sustain full IT load through two simultaneous failures of cooling infrastructure. Without published power capacity, square footage alone does not indicate whether IAD40 serves enterprise colocation, cloud platforms, or AI training workloads. Digital Realty operates multiple buildings across Northern Virginia as a contiguous campus; individual building power figures are not disclosed by the operator.

Virginia's 23 facilities with published power total 1,375 megawatts. IAD40 does not appear in that published set, so its contribution to the state's AI infrastructure capacity cannot be measured against its peers. The facility exists and operates, confirmed at its street address, but remains opaque to anyone tracking whether grid constraint is binding on AI scaling in this region.
